en: A black-and-white panoramic view over a European town with a large landscaped park in the foreground. Curving walking paths wind through open grassy areas planted with many small trees and shrubs, leading toward a pond or small lake with islands, bridges, and pavilions. Beyond the park lies a row of townhouses and larger urban buildings, including several multi‑story brick factories or warehouses with chimneys. A long masonry railway viaduct with a series of arches crosses the middle distance, while a church with a tall spire rises among dense townhouses further back. Low wooded hills form the horizon. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
